page_title: CoWork OS — Free, Open-Source AI Desktop App

sources.entry: CoWork OS - Open-source desktop AI agent for files, browser, and chat-app tasks that works with your own API keys or local models. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/CoWork-OS/CoWork-OS) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: CoWork OS
summary.one_liner: CoWork OS is a free, open-source AI desktop app that turns requests into documents, spreadsheets, presentations, web research and task automations on your computer, using the AI model you choose.
use_cases: turn meeting notes and metrics into a board deck
write release notes from git commits
rewrite guides and export to PDF
compare contract drafts in a table
summary.what_it_does: CoWork OS reads files, browses the web and runs commands inside a sandbox the user scopes. It plans multi-step tasks from plain-language requests and produces files such as documents, charts and presentations that can be reviewed and revised in the workspace. Destructive actions and spending require explicit approval. Bots can be given a trigger, sources, a review boundary and a budget, and they report back through channels such as Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram and Teams. Memory is kept as plain markdown notes that users can read, edit and roll back.
notable: Every step is visible and destructive or spending actions wait for approval
Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter and local models via Ollama
Sandboxed execution via macOS sandbox-exec, Docker or process-level isolation
Bots run on triggers and report back in chat apps, starting paused until enabled
caveats: Cloud model usage and subscriptions are billed by the provider; local models use your own hardware
Desktop apps are listed only for macOS on Apple Silicon (13+) and Windows 10/11; Linux and other systems use the CLI or self-hosting
Cloud providers may send the data needed for tasks to the provider
